# vMLX 1.6.53

## Changes

- Publish vMLX 1.6.52 updater manifest (`ddfa5f66`)
- feat(mtp): stock-MLX projection padding for native-MTP verify (default off) (`d90e8758`)
- feat(mtp): parameterize the native-MTP depth ceiling for measurement (`021f2451`)
- docs(mtp): record measured -38% full-graph loss of verify-pad dispatcher (`23fcc9bf`)
- feat(mtp): complete depth-ceiling parameterization (verifier + profile caps) (`7aae84f6`)
- fix(mtp): remove the residual depth-3 caps the first parameterization missed (`98a85df7`)
- perf(mtp): default the qwen4_exp q4 proposal head ON (`e2ae6bd8`)
- feat(mtp): q4 proposal head for the Qwen3.5/3.8 VLM MTP lane (default off) (`edf713d7`)
- feat(mtp): one-time per-bundle proposal-head stamp, honored on later launches (`bd279d74`)
- fix(mtp): confirm bundle type before stamping the proposal-head verdict (`4f9a479b`)
- fix(mtp): stamp confirmation gates bundle TYPE only — layout truth is the loaded head (`2693d6f5`)
- fix(mtp): require the JANG calibration marker before any proposal-head verdict (`be8f9014`)
- fix(mtp): absolute imports in qwen4_exp prepare_mtp_draft_head — relative import crashed server startup under the mlx_vlm namespace (`8bb04b01`)
- fix(mtp): a malformed eligible stamp is treated as absent, not a launch failure (`09a03959`)
- feat(mtp): consume converter-calibrated proposal-head tensors from the stamp (`187cd1dd`)
- feat(mtp): honor the converter draft_artifact schema with a single gated activation path (`3fba93b7`)
- Revert the calibrated proposal-artifact consumption (keep it simple) (`260623fa`)
- feat(panel): one-time dated redownload warning for Flash-Next MTP fix (`84155f30`)
- feat(qwen4_exp): final Flash-Next MTP bundle contract (index-driven weights + calibrated sidecar) (`d45aad0d`)
- feat(panel): MTP redownload warning localized + conformance-aware (`ddf4a161`)
- fix(panel): Qwen3.8 MTP sessions default to FIXED depth 3, not adaptive (`ed2e56d7`)
- fix(panel): language dropdown was clipped/covered — render in a body portal (`b84f3a5d`)
- Prepare vMLX 1.6.53 (`a1b9e2f5`)
- feat(mtp): policy-independent on-the-fly AR safety valve (windowed, context-scaled) (`4974c9d4`)
- fix(mtp): log the pre-trip depth in the AR-safety demotion line (`240abf88`)
- fix(mtp): AR-safety governor measures the real verify wall and ignores single stalls (`fb44f2db`)
- fix(mtp): AR-safety context scale uses the cycle wall bounded by context growth (`b8b4cb88`)
- docs: note the MTP AR safety valve in the 1.6.53 changelog (`0495eef9`)
- fix(mtp): AR safety valve runs in the text lane too, shared with the multimodal lane (`ef711efc`)
- perf(mtp): AR safety valve judges from cycle 16, no restored-prefix multiplier (`6ff72661`)
- fix(mtp): AR safety baseline follows the cycle wall so batching cannot false-trip (`7c8236ca`)
- fix(mtp): AR safety judges wall cost against the seed scaled by own-span growth (`05aefe2f`)
- feat(mtp): reversible AR fallback — measured AR tier with MTP re-entry probes (`5369c9be`)
- fix(mtp): AR safety baseline is a floor again; keep the last measured AR (`80a05662`)
- docs: describe AR-safety re-entry in the 1.6.53 changelog (`7d8fb2b4`)
- fix(mtp): a settled MTP re-entry that trips again counts a fallback and backs off (`82a6e93a`)
- fix(mtp): key the prompt-priming sidecar at the N-1 boundary the prefix cache restores (`4341c9b7`)
- test(mtp): priming tests follow the N-1 restore boundary contract (`e7d9b3a7`)
- docs: note the priming boundary fix in the 1.6.53 changelog (`7ad06d79`)
